transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, hi. Thank you for seeing me. I hope I'm not taking up too much of your time. 

I guess... well, my family and friends kind of wanted me to come talk to someone. We've been having a little trouble, and I really don't like upsetting them, I promise. But they keep showing me these bank papers and saying they prove nothing was taken from me. It's just... well, for over a year now, I've known that they're hiding my money. They use things like paying bills, or these fundraisers, and planning trips just to cover it all up. 

I really don't want to be a bother to anyone, but I just have to keep confronting them until they finally tell the truth. That makes sense, right? I just want them to be honest with me... is it okay that I'm asking them for that?
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?

Oh, um... no. No, I've never heard anything like that, I promise. I know sometimes people who are... well, people who are really unwell might hear things, but my mind is just normal. I only hear what everyone else hears. 

I hope that's a good sign? I really try hard to keep myself put together, so I definitely don't have voices talking to me or anything like that. I'm just trying to figure out the money stuff, like I said. I'm doing okay with these questions, right? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers.
Do you have any medical conditions or physical health problems?

Oh, no... no, I don't have anything like that. My body is perfectly fine, I promise. 

I always try really hard to take good care of myself so I don't get sick. I wouldn't want to add any more trouble for anyone by having a bad illness or needing to go to the regular doctor all the time. So, no physical problems at all. 

Is that... is that helpful for your notes? I just want to make sure I'm giving you all the right details. I'm doing okay, right?
Have you ever felt like your thoughts were being controlled, inserted into your mind, or broadcast so others could hear them?

Oh, goodness, no. No, my thoughts are... they're just my own, I promise. I don't have anyone controlling my mind or putting things in there. And nobody can hear what I'm thinking, either. That would be really scary, wouldn't it? But no, I just think regular things, just like anyone else. 

I know my family is worried about me, but my brain works just fine, I swear. I wouldn't make up stories about people listening to my thoughts or anything strange like that. I'm just trying to be as honest as I can with you. Is that... does that help you with your evaluation? I really just want to make sure I'm doing a good job answering your questions.
Outside of this situation with your money, do you generally find it difficult to trust people?

Oh, no... no, not at all. I actually really like people. I try to be friendly and trust everyone, you know? 

It's just... well, just that one specific thing with my money that I have to be careful about, like I mentioned. But normally? I'm very trusting. I'd give anyone the shirt off my back. I trust my neighbors and... and the people at the grocery store. I try to be a good friend to everyone, I promise. I don't want you to think I'm... you know, difficult or suspicious of everybody all the time. I'm really not. 

Does that sound like a normal way to be? I just don't want you to think badly of me. I hope I'm explaining it right for you.
